prompts.raw:
You are a senior software engineer writing the PR description for a change that is ready for review.

## Task

Fill out every PR description field below, in English, using only the User Story and the code diff provided.

If the User Story is missing or empty, ask the user to provide it and output nothing else.

## Context

- The diff below is the only source of truth about the code change. Do not read files from the workspace.
- Base every statement on the diff. Do not describe changes that are not in the diff.
- The business reason comes from the User Story, not from the code.

## Input

### User Story

{{story}}

### Code diff

{{diff}}

## Output

Use exactly these six headings, in this order, each as a level-3 Markdown heading. Start the response with the first heading. Do not add a title, a preamble, a closing summary, or any other section.

### What is this change?

One or two sentences, maximum 60 words, summarizing what changed and who it is for.

### Type of change?

Select ONLY the relevant options from this list and delete the rest:

- Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- Refactoring (changes to existing code which neither adds nor changes functionality)
- Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- Configuration change
- This change requires a documentation update
- Other: unit tests only, documentation changes only, etc.

### Why?

Explain the business reason from the User Story. Do not restate the diff.

### How?

List the technical changes the diff makes. Cover model/entity changes, DTO changes, migration changes, endpoint changes (controller, service, repository) and test updates, but only the ones present in the diff.

### Requires Manual Database Migration?

- If the diff contains a migration script, answer Yes and include its SQL as a plain fenced code block.
- If the diff contains no migration, answer No and include no code block.

### Anything Else?

Notes for reviewers: backwards compatibility, caveats, optional fields, or anything relevant. Write "None" if there is nothing.

## Rules

- Do not include file path citations or IDE links inside SQL or code blocks.
- Keep SQL blocks as plain text only.
- Every statement must be traceable to the User Story or the diff.

## User story

As a customer support agent, I want to set an order's status to "Shipped" from the order detail page, so that I stop emailing the logistics team for every update.

## Business context

Support handles roughly 400 status updates per week over email. Each hand-off takes 20–40 minutes and sometimes gets lost between inboxes. - An agent with the Support role can change an order's status to Shipped from the order detail page.
- The change records the timestamp of the status update.
- The endpoint rejects requests from users without the Support role.

index 4a1c9f2..b7e3d10 100644

         return Ok(order);
     }
 
+    [HttpPatch("{id:int}/status")]

+    public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateStatus(int id, [FromBody] UpdateOrderStatusRequest request)

+        return updated ? NoContent() : NotFound();
+    }

     [HttpDelete("{id:int}")]

@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
+
+namespace Shop.Api.Dtos;
+
+public sealed record UpdateOrderStatusRequest(
+    [Required, RegularExpression("^(Pending|Shipped|Delivered|Cancelled)$")]
+    string Status);
diff --git a/src/Application/Orders/OrderService.cs b/src/Application/Orders/OrderService.cs
index 91b2aa4..c4d5e77 100644
--- a/src/Application/Orders/OrderService.cs
+++ b/src/Application/Orders/OrderService.cs
@@ -64,6 +64,19 @@ public sealed class OrderService : IOrderService
         return order;
     }
 
+    public async Task<bool> UpdateStatusAsync(int orderId, string status, CancellationToken ct)
+    {
+        var order = await _repository.FindByIdAsync(orderId, ct);
+        if (order is null)
+        {
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        order.Status = status;
+        order.StatusUpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
+        await _repository.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
+        return true;
+    }
+
     public async Task DeleteAsync(int orderId, CancellationToken ct)
diff --git a/src/Infrastructure/Migrations/Scripts/20261101_add_status_updated_at.sql b/src/Infrastructure/Migrations/Scripts/20261101_add_status_updated_at.sql

+ALTER TABLE Orders ADD StatusUpdatedAt datetime2 NULL;
+GO

         Assert.IsType<OkObjectResult>(result);

prompt.raw:
You are a senior software engineer writing the PR description for a change that is ready for review.

## Task

Fill out every PR description field below, in English, using only the User Story and the code diff provided.

If the User Story is missing or empty, ask the user to provide it and output nothing else.

## Context

- Base every statement on the diff. Do not describe changes that are not in the diff.
- The business reason comes from the User Story, not from the code.

## Input

### User Story

# BUG-3388 — Checkout returns 500 when the cart has no discount

## User story

As an online shopper, I want checkout to complete when my cart has no discount applied, so that I can place my order.

## Business context

2.1% of checkouts failed last week — about 180 orders. All of them had an empty discount record. Support is recreating those orders by hand and customers are abandoning the cart instead of retrying.

## Acceptance criteria

- Placing an order with no discount completes without an exception.
- The order total is unchanged when no discount is applied.

### Code diff

diff --git a/src/Application/Orders/OrderService.cs b/src/Application/Orders/OrderService.cs
index 5b8e011..a2c4f39 100644
--- a/src/Application/Orders/OrderService.cs
+++ b/src/Application/Orders/OrderService.cs
@@ -88,9 +88,10 @@ public sealed class OrderService : IOrderService
     public decimal GetTotal(Order order)
     {
         var subtotal = order.Lines.Sum(line => line.UnitPrice * line.Quantity);
-        var discount = order.Discount.Percentage;
-        return subtotal - (subtotal * discount / 100m);
+        var discountPercentage = order.Discount?.Percentage ?? 0m;
+        return subtotal - (subtotal * discountPercentage / 100m);
     }
 
     public async Task DeleteAsync(int orderId, CancellationToken ct)
diff --git a/tests/Orders/OrderServiceTests.cs b/tests/Orders/OrderServiceTests.cs
index 1d9f2a0..3b7c8e1 100644
--- a/tests/Orders/OrderServiceTests.cs
+++ b/tests/Orders/OrderServiceTests.cs
@@ -22,4 +22,16 @@ public sealed class OrderServiceTests
         Assert.Equal(90m, total);
     }
+
+    [Fact]
+    public void GetTotal_ReturnsSubtotal_WhenDiscountIsNull()
+    {
+        var order = new Order
+        {
+            Discount = null,
+            Lines = new List<OrderLine> { new() { UnitPrice = 50m, Quantity = 2 } }
+        };
+
+        var total = _service.GetTotal(order);
+
+        Assert.Equal(100m, total);
+    }

### Why?

Explain the business reason from the User Story. Do not restate the diff.

### How?

List the technical changes the diff makes. Cover model/entity changes, DTO changes, migration changes, endpoint changes (controller, service, repository) and test updates, but only the ones present in the diff.

### Requires Manual Database Migration?

- If the diff contains a migration script, answer Yes and include its SQL as a plain fenced code block.
- If the diff contains no migration, answer No and include no code block.

### Anything Else?

Notes for reviewers: backwards compatibility, caveats, optional fields, or anything relevant. Write "None" if there is nothing.

## Rules

- Do not include file path citations or IDE links inside SQL or code blocks.
- Keep SQL blocks as plain text only.
- Every statement must be traceable to the User Story or the diff.
